caption: The drawing depicts a marionette puppet suspended by five black strings attached to its head and both hands. The puppet has a large, painted face with exaggerated features, including prominent eyes, long eyebrows, a pointed nose, and red lips. It wears a light pink headscarf tied at the neck, a black or dark blue coat with brown fur trim at the cuffs and collar, and a blue garment with a pattern underneath the coat. The puppet’s hands and face are flesh-toned with a reddish hue, and the clothing and strings are painted in rich, opaque colors. The background is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or scenery. The artist’s signature, "James Pilletton," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Lady Marionette
